description: USAGE FLOAT-BINARY-128 (ISO/IEC 60559:2020 binary128, §2023:13.18.60.4 GR16) — a COBOL-2014 introduction that is PROCESSOR-DEPENDENT (Annex A.3 item 17). PENDING: .NET has no IEEE 754 binary128 type and GR16 pins the format, so WiseOwl COBOL documents it as non-support (rejected loud, COBOL1564) rather than a non-conforming double-backed approximation; this row would activate if the pinned format is implemented.
citation: ISO §2023:13.18.60.4 GR16 (binary128); Annex A.3 item 17 (processor-dependent); non-support COBOL1564
